name: Project proposal

title: "project: "
labels: project
---

**The task, in one sentence.**

**Why this task can separate methodologies** — what a process, a guardrail or a stop rule has to act
on here. A task every arm passes ranks by cost alone.

**Size** — roughly how much code the agent must read and write, and where it would sit against the
existing ladder (`01_python_small` … `04_python_xlarge`).

**Runtime** — Python version and dependencies.

**Do you have a reference solution?** The oracle constants are measured from it; without one the
project cannot be scored. See CONTRIBUTING.md.

**Held-out suite** — what it would test, and confirmation that it tests only what `prompt.md`
states.
